newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU seen valuing early May French wheat around $167.
newsitem.headline: EU seen valuing early May French wheat around $167.

text.p: A European Union award of 91,200 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 7.49 Ecus per tonne values a tonne of early May French wheat at $167.31 per tonne, Reuters calculates.

The figure, which should be regarded as an estimate only, is based on benchmark standard-quality French milling wheat at Rouen and may vary significantly for other EU origins and types, as well as depending on dollar and other variables used.
The calculation uses the following assumptions gathered from market sources and Reuters data.
Implied fob price in dollars $167.31 dollars/tonne
The same formula suggests an unsubsidised French fob price of $177.42 per tonne. May U.S. soft red winter $154 per tonne.
